ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for Thermodynamics: operator grammar for temperature, entropy, free energy, equilibrium, and coherence under constraint.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of temperature, entropy, free energy, and equilibrium within the RTT substrate.

temperature_operator.description: Drives motion, structure, and regime behavior; defines energy distribution.

entropy_operator.description: Defines coherence limits and regime transitions; measures accessible configurations.

free_energy_operator.description: Determines whether systems move toward structure or dispersion.

equilibrium_operator.description: Defines stable configurations where flows and gradients vanish.

heat_flow_operator.description: Describes energy flow driven by temperature differences.

partition_function.description: Encodes the weighted structure of all accessible states.

state_space_volume.description: Measures the number of accessible microstates.

gradient_operator.description: Defines directional change in temperature, pressure, or potential.

dissipation_operator.description: Represents irreversible processes that increase entropy.

dimensional_mapping.R1: Thermodynamics collapses; temperature undefined; coherence dominated by quantum behavior.
dimensional_mapping.R2: Local equilibrium; stable gradients; predictable free energy flow.
dimensional_mapping.R3: Large-scale structure; dissipation; stable thermodynamic cycles.
dimensional_mapping.R4: Cosmological thermodynamics; horizon behavior; expansion-driven gradients.

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats Thermodynamics as a substrate grammar; deeper resonance and multi-regime integration occur in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
